summary: Adversarial review of block 3 (Porsche handling), done by hand in the session of 4 Oct 2026 (third), after the user asked not to use multi-agent workflows. Three lenses: code (the diff read line by line), realism (each new figure against Porsche's press kits), and a spin hunter (headless fuzzing with the keyboard's ramps on the circuit's real surfaces).

method.code: git diff of src/sim/gt3*.js, src/data/gt3rs.js, src/ui/gt3Hud.js, src/main.js read line by line; HUD checked on a browser screenshot.
method.realism: PSM stages: 911 GT3 press kit (newsroom.porsche.com, PAG-911-GT3-RS-EN.pdf, in fact the 992 GT3's): 'Porsche Stability Management (PSM) incl. ABS, with optional deactivation in two stages (ESC OFF and ESC+TC OFF)'; 'the PSM of the new 911 GT3 can be switched off either fully or with the exception of the traction control (TC) system'. 992 GT3 RS press kit: 'Stability Control (ESC) and Traction Control (TC) are multi-stage, adjustable from the steering wheel and can be completely deactivated'. Rear-axle steering: GT3 press kit, opposite up to ~50 km/h by up to 2.0 deg, same direction above 80 km/h by up to 2.0 deg.
method.spin: 150 random 20 s drives per PSM stage, keys changed every 0.3-1.8 s among W, S, A, D, their pairs, Space with a turn and W+S, with the same ramps as gt3Drive.readControls, started on a random station of the circuit with circuitSurface as the ground (track, kerb, verge, gravel, grass off it). Script: /tmp (lost with the session); its logic is in this file's 'spin' entry.

off.note: almost all full throttle on grass or gravel at 30-40 km/h; one on asphalt with full throttle and full lock at 29 km/h (power oversteer, expected with no aids)

findings.title: Chase camera flips round in reverse
findings.evidence: Above 4 m/s the heading mixes the nose (0.45) with the velocity (0.55); in reverse the velocity points backwards and the mix is -0.1 x the nose: the camera swings in front of the car. Pre-existing in gt3Drive.js.
findings.fix: Use the velocity only while going forward (s.u > 1).

findings.title: HUD: the LOCK label overlapped the PSM stage
findings.fix: Stage label at cy+20, LOCK at cy+38, its bar at cy+46.

findings.title: A first test of the load-dependent relaxation was a tautology
findings.evidence: It recomputed the formula in the test instead of reading the model; it could not fail.
findings.fix: The model exports relaxationLength() and uses it; the test reads that. The yaw step test (t90 112 ms, 100 ms before) is kept only as a regression guard (0.10-0.22 s), not as proof of the change.

findings.title: Neither the driver's nor the bonnet camera rolled with the body
findings.evidence: lookAt with the world's up: the horizon stayed level whatever the car did (the diagnosis assumed the opposite).
findings.fix: Up from the sprung body's quaternion: the bonnet camera takes all of it, the driver about half (≈).

not_done: The GT3 RS's multi-stage TC rotary (stages not published by Porsche; forum figures only).
The manual DRS button the GT3 RS has ('the DRS can also be operated manually using the DRS button', press kit): the model keeps the automatic DRS.
The circuit has no corner taken at 200 km/h or more, so the g-g-V guard covers 60/100/150 km/h only.
